notes.title: Telescape Demo Update 1.2
notes.notes:
This update includes some balance changes, quality of life improvements and bug fixes.

Furthermore, a lot of work is currently going into testing saga 2 of the complete game and enhancing the visuals. Here is a teaser for the improved kitchen. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623739/b9f0be0ff461621ba523819c47030a853dd4e671.png[/img] 

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed some text in the main menu
[*] Added a hint to a hidden quest in the Achievement Lounge
[/list]

[h3]Into the Maze[/h3]
[list]
[*] The monster now waits a bit after teleporting before she starts moving again, unless she spots the player of course...
[*] Alarms in the maze now show a visual indication when they are triggered
[*] Increased the volume of the alarm sound when an alarm is triggered
[*] Added a ticking sound to the red rocks in the maze as an indication that one is nearby
[*] Added some clear and distinct landmarks in the maze
[*] Added death screens hinting at hint features accessible in the options menu
[/list]

[h3]Extended Innovations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the second half of the reception area and replaced it with a less tedious sequence
[*] Removed a softlock in the reception area
[*] Removed the life system. Instead, one can choose to restart from the last checkpoint or the last save point after death
[*] All janitor rooms are now safe areas
[*] The monster now waits a bit after teleporting before she starts moving again, unless she spots the player of course...
[*] Added a sound effect for pressing a timer panel
[*] Added a sound effect for when a timer panel ticks down one number
[*] Rocks that can be blown up now have an orange indication
[*] Added some extra hint text in the main area of the facility to guide the player better through that area
[*] Code screens now require only one input. Code screens with multiple inputs will have all but one random input solved before starting the level
[*] Changed the font in some areas
[*] Changed a texture to provide a clearer hint
[*] Adjusted the hitbox of the power generators that do not turn on and off by themselves
[*] Made changes to the finance department to ensure the player does everything that should be done before moving on
[*] Changed the look of the elevator
[*] Elevator music no longer overlays the other music tracks
[*] Added death screens hinting at keyboard controls for the keypad and hint features accessible in the options menu
[*] Changed an achievement from a reception challenge to collecting a specific folder in the Lore Hunter gamemode
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the monster not to be teleported after being shot
[*] Pop-ups could show up twice in the reception area
[*] The main area of the facility did not always reset to the correct configuration
[*] Movement carts no longer move slowly or teleport when activated with a button
[*] The monster can now walk between the ground floor corridors and the stairs
[*] Finance panels no longer assume that no input equals the number 0
[*] Removed a sudden and unexplained death in the reception area
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes:
This update introduces a safe zone in Extended Innovations, a restart button for Gravity Gauntlet, as well as some fixes to improve the clarity of puzzles.

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[h2]Into The Maze[/h2]

[list]
[*] Made the monster less likely to spawn relatively close to the player
[/list]

[h2]Extended Innovations[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]The janitor's closet on the ground floor is now a safe area, as long as you're not being chased into it...[/b]
[*] Added a dance floor pattern on the karaoke stage
[*] Added a death screen specifically for being killed by the monster after using a teleporter
[*] Changed the landing cushion in the manufacturing hall to be more obvious 
[*] Clarified the puzzle in the finances room
[*] Clarified the light sphere puzzle
[*] Escape can now be used to leave the elevator panel and code panel menus
[*] Fixed an issue where a code could be retrieved behind a gate in the kitchen
[*] Fixed an issue where a voiceline could be activated early
[*] Lives are now reset after a save point
[*] Made holes in floors and ceiling more noticeable
[*] Made the monster a bit more merciful during the light sphere puzzle
[*] Reduced the cost of using teleporters
[*] Simplified the code panel in the security room
[*] Teleportable Blocks will now be more likely to move greater distances instead of a couple of centimeters
[*] The elevator panel can no longer be interacted with while the elevator is moving
[/list]

[h2]Gravity Gauntlet[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a restart button. This button resets the level to the previous checkpoint
[*] Fixed incorrect numbering on a chamber screen
[*] Made it so gravity doors no longer have a ledge to stand on, which made various chambers trivial
[*] Made GBlocks more consistent; they won't get stuck as often anymore
[*] Moved some ammo chests to prevent a clipping issue
[*] Made glass walls more clearly visible
[*] Fixed issues where GBlocks would not fall after a block was exploded or teleported
[/list]

notes.title: Telescape Demo Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Alongside of the release of a new trailer showcasing the improved environments for the full game, here is a minor update to the demo featuring similar lighting improvements, some performance improvements and more.

[h1][h2]Changes[/h2][/h1]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Control rebinds. Rebind the controls in the controls menu of each saga, accessible through the how to play menu in the pause menu
[*] Improved loading times
[/list]

[h2]Into The Maze[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Randomization IsoLocator now has a flashlight. Toggle it with F	
[*] Improved the lighting
[*] Hard mode now has a slightly different look
[/list]

[h2]Extended Innovations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the lighting. It is much darker now
[*] The flashlight can now be toggled with F
[*] The flashlight is a lot brighter
[*] Updated the look of the freezer and garden
[*] Respawning after a checkpoint now turns the player in the right direction
[/list]

[h2]Gravity Gauntlet[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the lighting
[*] Polished the coloured parts of the GBlocks and TBlocks
[/list]

[h2]Renovation trailer[/h2]
Also, check out this trailer showing off some new areas that are planned to appear in the final game
[previewyoutube=5BxlsVLK3Y4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
After some initial feedback, the monster has been made a bit more merciful. This should make it a bit easier to get to the other two sagas.

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[h3]Into The Maze[/h3]
[list]
[*] The monster's maximum speed has been reduced.
[*] The monster will wait for the player to get to the maze before moving around.
[*] Added a death screen tip explaining how to deal with alarms.
[/list]
